preconditions.description: The number of teams n is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.
Each team beats the other teams exactly k times, where k is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The number of played games m is equal to the total number of matches required for each team to beat every other team exactly k times.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n and 1 <= b_i <= n and a_i != b_i for a_i, b_i in matches)
postconditions.description: Each match involves two distinct teams, each numbered between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(matches.count((a_i, b_i)) == 1 for a_i, b_i in matches)
postconditions.description: Each pair of teams plays against each other at most once.

postconditions.expression: all(matches.count((i, j)) == k for i in range(1, n+1) for j in range(1, n+1) if i != j)
postconditions.description: Each team beats every other team exactly k times.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 if m != n * (n - 1) * k // 2 else True
postconditions.description: If the number of matches required is not achievable, output -1. Otherwise, the output is valid.
